rules.cssText: .box { position: absolute; background: rgb(215, 233, 223); width: 150px; height: 60px; padding: 8px; }
#nested { position: absolute; left: 40px; top: 40px; width: 180px; height: 60px; }
#transformed { left: 260px; top: 180px; width: 100px; height: 60px; transform: rotate(10deg); }
#sticky-scroll { left: 450px; top: 180px; height: 130px; overflow: auto; padding: 0px; }
#sticky { position: sticky; top: 0px; height: 35px; background: rgb(187, 187, 187); }
#scroller { left: 40px; top: 340px; width: 250px; height: 140px; overflow: auto; padding: 0px; }
#clip { left: 340px; top: 340px; width: 80px; height: 60px; overflow: hidden; padding: 0px; }
#tiny { position: absolute; left: 40px; top: 560px; width: 1px; height: 1px; background: red; }
#svg-case { position: absolute; left: 150px; top: 550px; width: 320px; height: 120px; }
#pseudo::before { content: "BEFORE"; display: block; background: rgb(187, 221, 255); height: 20px; }
#pseudo::after { content: "AFTER"; display: block; background: rgb(255, 221, 187); height: 20px; }
#open-host, #outer-host, #slot-host, #closed-host { position: absolute; top: 740px; display: block; width: 140px; height: 60px; }
iframe { position: absolute; top: 840px; width: 260px; height: 125px; border: 4px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); }
cssforge-ui { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; width: 0px; height: 0px; pointer-events: none; }
